name_zh: 乌尔马尼斯/拉脱维亚/独裁/独立：两次独立与威权转型
description_zh: 卡尔利斯·乌尔马尼斯 (1877-1942) 拉脱维亚总理/总统/1918 独立/农会/1934 政变/威权/独裁/拉脱维亚/方式/苏联/占领/1940/流亡/西伯利亚/逝世/两次/独立/威权/转型/遗产/乌尔马尼斯/拉脱维亚。核心模式：两次独立威权转型 — 独立/政变/威权/苏联/占领/流亡/两次/独立/遗产/乌尔马尼斯/拉脱维亚。体现 M259 两次独立/威权/转型 — 以"独立+政变+威权+占领"四位一体，在德国/苏联/大国/小国四重地缘夹击中构建拉脱维亚两次独立威权转型范式。
description_en: Karlis Ulmanis (1877-1942) Latvia PM/President/1918 independence/Farmers Union/1934 coup/authoritarian/dictatorship/Latvian/way/Soviet/occupation/1940/exile/Siberia/death/two/independences/authoritarian/transition/legacy/Ulmanis/Latvia. Core model: Two Independences Authoritarian Transition — independence/coup/authoritarian/Soviet/occupation/exile/two/independences/legacy/Ulmanis/Latvia. Exemplifies M259 Two Independences/Authoritarian Transition — quaternity of 'independence + coup + authoritarianism + occupation' building Latvian two independences authoritarian transition paradigm amid quadruple geopolitical squeeze of Germany/USSR/great powers/small state.
reason_zh: 乌尔马尼斯非单纯独裁者，而是"独立+政变+威权+占领"四位一体两次建国者。1918 首次建国，1934 威权巩固，1940 苏联吞并。M259 区隔于 M257 曼纳海姆中立(曼纳海姆)、M258 爱沙尼亚数字(伊尔韦斯)、M260 立陶宛语言(斯梅特纳)，核心在于"独立即生存意志+政变即秩序重构+威权即防御姿态+占领即历史循环"的拉脱维亚两次独立威权转型范式。
reason_en: Ulmanis not mere dictator but 'independence + coup + authoritarianism + occupation' quaternity two-time nation-builder. 1918 first independence, 1934 authoritarian consolidation, 1940 Soviet annexation. M259 distinct from M257 Mannerheim Neutrality (Mannerheim), M258 Estonia Digital (Ilves), M260 Lithuania Language (Smetona), core: 'independence as survival will + coup as order reconstruction + authoritarianism as defense posture + occupation as historical cycle' Latvian two independences authoritarian transition paradigm.
